extras: Fully local and private; the plugin makes no network requests, uploads nothing, and collects no data.
intentEvidence: Turn folders and tags into a continuous, draggable reference stream — for effortless long-form writing.
problem: Writing long-form content often requires jumping between different notes, tabs, and split panes, which is disruptive.
summary: SlipStream transforms folders and tags into a continuous, draggable card stream to facilitate long-form writing and citation.
